evals.prompt: Create a card with a title, description, and a form in the content area.
evals.expected_output: IGRPCard with IGRPCardHeader (IGRPCardTitle, IGRPCardDescription), IGRPCardContent with form.
expectations: Uses full IGRPCard composition: IGRPCardHeader, IGRPCardContent, and IGRPCardFooter — not a flat structure with everything in IGRPCardContent
Uses IGRPCardTitle inside IGRPCardHeader for the title
Uses IGRPCardDescription inside IGRPCardHeader for the subtitle
Uses IGRPForm with a Zod schema and formRef — not a raw <form> element
File has 'use client' directive at the top
Uses semantic color tokens instead of raw Tailwind colors like text-gray-500
Uses gap-* for spacing instead of space-y-* or space-x-*

evals.prompt: Display user profile as a read-only card with name, email, and role fields.
evals.expected_output: IGRPCardDetails with items array for label/content pairs.
expectations: Uses IGRPCardDetails instead of a manually composed IGRPCard with label/value divs
Passes an items array with objects containing label and content properties
Passes title and description props directly to IGRPCardDetails — not wrapping it in a separate IGRPCardHeader
File has 'use client' directive at the top
